topic: STDP（脉冲时序依赖可塑性）的分子机制与体内证据

sources.title: Regulation of synaptic efficacy by coincidence of postsynaptic APs and EPSPs
sources.authors: Markram H, Lübke J, Frotscher M, Sakmann B
sources.key_finding: 新皮质双全细胞记录证明突触可塑性方向由突触前EPSP与突触后AP的精确时序决定，回传动作电位是关键

sources.title: Synaptic modifications in cultured hippocampal neurons: dependence on spike timing, synaptic strength, and postsynaptic cell type
sources.key_finding: 培养海马神经元中系统确立STDP学习窗口：前先后随Δt +5至+40ms→LTP；后先前随Δt-5至-70ms→LTD；NMDA受体依赖

sources.title: Spike timing-dependent plasticity of neural circuits
sources.key_finding: 综述：STDP是神经回路塑形的基础机制，涉及多种突触类型，延伸了传统Hebbian相关可塑性的概念

sources.title: The spike-timing dependence of plasticity
sources.key_finding: 综述：时序只是多因素可塑性之一；STDP在体内功能证据存在但需结合更广泛框架理解

sources.title: Calcium and Spike Timing-Dependent Plasticity
covers: in vivo vs in vitro discrepancy
sources.key_finding: 生理细胞外Ca²⁺浓度（1.3-1.8mM）下，用标准低频配对方案无法可靠诱导LTP；经典STDP实验使用的高Ca²⁺（2-3mM）可能不代表体内条件

sources.title: Spike-timing-dependent plasticity rewards synchrony rather than causality
sources.authors: Anisimova M, van Bommel B, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya S, Bhattacharya S, Bhatt DL et al.
sources.key_finding: 光遗传3天追踪：短期STDP依赖因果顺序；长期记忆依赖同步性（无论前先后随还是后先前随，只要同步均→LTP）

sources.title: AMPA receptors gate spine Ca²⁺ transients and spike-timing-dependent potentiation
sources.authors: Holbro N, Grunditz A, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya S
sources.key_finding: AMPA受体是STDP时间精度的调节器；bAP+EPSP重叠时产生超线性Ca²⁺叠加；孤立棘效应最强

sources.title: Modulation of Spike-Timing Dependent Plasticity: Towards the Inclusion of a Third Factor in Computational Models
sources.authors: Foncelle A, Mendes A, Jędrzejewska-Szmek J, Valtcheva S, Berry H, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya S
sources.key_finding: 多巴胺、乙酰胆碱、去甲肾上腺素均能调制STDP规则；三因素规则（STDP×调制因子）是更完整的学习模型

sources.title: Targeted Modulation of Human Brain Interregional Effective Connectivity With Spike-Timing Dependent Plasticity
sources.authors: Hernandez-Pavon JC, Schneider-Garces N, Begnoche JP, Bhatt DL, Bhattacharya S
sources.key_finding: 人类双线圈TMS证明人类运动皮质中存在STDP-like规则：前先后随→M1-M1连接增强，后先前随→减弱，效果翻转符合STDP预测
